# Preisser Solutions

> AI automation, custom software, and AI search optimization for serious businesses.

Preisser Solutions is a business automation and web development firm headquartered in Hays, Kansas. We build AI agents, automation systems, custom websites, web applications, and dashboards for small and mid-sized businesses across Kansas and the Great Plains, with select remote engagements nationwide. Founded in 2023 and led by Tyler Preisser. Every engagement is handled directly — no subcontractors, no offshore teams, no template builds.

## Services

- [Custom Website Development](https://preissersolutions.com/services/custom-websites) — Custom-coded, high-performance websites built for conversion, speed, and AI search visibility.
- [AI Automation](https://preissersolutions.com/services/ai-automation) — AI agents, document processing, customer reactivation, lead routing, after-hours triage, and AI-native workflow systems.
- [Business Automation](https://preissersolutions.com/services/business-automation) — End-to-end automation of invoicing, scheduling, data entry, reporting, and operational workflows.
- [Custom Web Applications](https://preissersolutions.com/services/custom-web-applications) — Client portals, booking systems, internal tools, dashboards, and full-stack custom applications.
- [Dashboards](https://preissersolutions.com/services/dashboards) — Power BI and custom reporting dashboards that replace manual reconciliation with real-time visibility.
- [Local SEO](https://preissersolutions.com/services/local-seo) — Google Business Profile optimization, local citation building, review systems, and technical SEO for Kansas service businesses.
- [AI Search Optimization](https://preissersolutions.com/services/ai-search-optimization) — Generative engine optimization (GEO) and answer engine optimization (AEO) so businesses appear in ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, and Google AI Overviews answers.

## Case Studies

- [Case Studies](https://preissersolutions.com/case-studies) — All documented client outcomes.
- [Cassidy HVAC — AI Customer Reactivation Engine](https://preissersolutions.com/case-studies/cassidy-hvac-reactivation) — 60%+ dormant customer reactivation in 6 weeks, 45%+ booking conversion lift.
- [Cassidy HVAC — AI Marketing Engine](https://preissersolutions.com/case-studies/cassidy-hvac-marketing) — 5x organic reach in 30 days; replaced outsourced marketing agency.
- [HG Oil Holdings — Inventory Management System](https://preissersolutions.com/case-studies/hg-oil-inventory) — 95% reduction in back-office logistics time, 75%+ accuracy improvement.
- [HG Oil Holdings — AI Invoice Processing](https://preissersolutions.com/case-studies/hg-oil-invoices) — 75% reduction in manual invoice handling time.
- [MGU / Alliant Insurance Ecosystem — AI Submission Processing](https://preissersolutions.com/case-studies/insurance-submission-processing) — Dual-model AI extraction, Salesforce integration, zero missed renewals in 6 months.
- [Bus Transportation Operator — Power BI Dashboard Suite](https://preissersolutions.com/case-studies/transportation-dashboard) — Full-day reconciliation reduced to 15-minute exception queue; approximately 1 FTE of work eliminated.
- [Iron and Oak Podcast](https://preissersolutions.com/case-studies/iron-and-oak-podcast) — 134-page cinematic media brand with AI search optimization, built with Next.js and GSAP.
- [Wife Supply Co](https://preissersolutions.com/case-studies/wife-supply-co) — AI-powered gifting platform with custom matching engine, from concept to deployment.
